description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Wind], [Lazy Mirage] and [Swirling Storm Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Lazy Mirage
description.text: Grants [Physical High Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the front row after using a Wind ability

description.name: Swirling Storm Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Swirling Storm after using a Wind ability
